### Topic: Signed Area and the 2D Determinant

**Key Points**:
* For a matrix \(M=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}\), the determinant is \(\det(M)=ad-bc\). Its magnitude gives the area of the transformed unit square.
* The columns of \(M\) are the transformed basis vectors. The four corners remain identifiable as \(O\), \(u\), \(v\), and \(u+v\).
* For \(A=\begin{bmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{bmatrix}\), the determinant is \(2\): the parallelogram has area 2 and preserves counterclockwise orientation.
* For \(B=\begin{bmatrix}-1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix}\), the determinant is \(-1\): the reflected square has ordinary area 1 but reversed orientation. The minus sign describes orientation, not negative physical area.

**Visual Elements**:
* Animate the unit square and its colored basis vectors into the parallelogram defined by \(A\).
* Show a fresh unit square reflected by \(B\), keeping corresponding corner colors and labels consistent.
* Demonstrate orientation by tracing the corners in the same order before and after each transformation.

**Style**:
Use a clean geometric presentation with fixed explanatory text above the diagram and corner labels offset outside the shapes. Smooth transformations and a bright moving tracer distinguish area changes from orientation changes.

```python
from manim import *
import numpy as np


class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#101722"

        title = Text("Signed area and the 2D determinant", font_size=34)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.25)
        rule = MathTex(
            r"M=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}"
            r"\qquad\det(M)=ad-bc",
            font_size=31,
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.18)
        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(rule), run_time=1)

        plane = NumberPlane(
            x_range=[-2, 4, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 2, 1],
            x_length=7.2,
            y_length=3.6,
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.18},
            axis_config={"stroke_opacity": 0.55},
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.85)
        self.add(plane)

        colors = [WHITE, RED_C, YELLOW_C, GREEN_C]
        names = [r"O", r"u", r"u+v", r"v"]
        unit = np.array([[0., 0.], [1., 0.], [1., 1.], [0., 1.]])
        normal_offsets = [
            DL * 0.25, DR * 0.25, UR * 0.29, UL * 0.29
        ]
        reflected_offsets = [
            DR * 0.25, DL * 0.25, UL * 0.29, UR * 0.29
        ]

        legend = VGroup(
            MathTex(r"u=M e_1", color=RED_C, font_size=27),
            MathTex(r"v=M e_2", color=GREEN_C, font_size=27),
            MathTex(r"\text{fourth corner}=u+v", color=YELLOW_C, font_size=27),
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.55).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.25)
        self.add(legend)

        def point(xy):
            return plane.c2p(float(xy[0]), float(xy[1]))

        def geometry(vertices, offsets):
            pts = [point(xy) for xy in vertices]
            patch = Polygon(
                *pts, color=BLUE_C, fill_color=BLUE_D,
                fill_opacity=0.35, stroke_width=3,
            )
            basis = VGroup(
                Arrow(pts[0], pts[1], buff=0, color=RED_C, stroke_width=6),
                Arrow(pts[0], pts[3], buff=0, color=GREEN_C, stroke_width=6),
            )
            dots = VGroup(*[
                Dot(p, radius=0.055, color=c)
                for p, c in zip(pts, colors)
            ])
            labels = VGroup(*[
                MathTex(name, color=c, font_size=26).move_to(p + offset)
                for name, c, p, offset in zip(names, colors, pts, offsets)
            ])
            return VGroup(patch, basis, dots, labels)

        def trace(vertices, caption):
            pts = [point(xy) for xy in vertices]
            path = VMobject().set_points_as_corners(pts + [pts[0]])
            tracer = Dot(pts[0], radius=0.09, color=ORANGE)
            text = Text(caption, font_size=24, color=ORANGE)
            text.move_to([0, -3.05, 0])
            self.add(tracer, text)
            self.play(MoveAlongPath(tracer, path), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
            self.remove(tracer, text)

        # First example: positive determinant. Begin with a unit square.
        heading_a = MathTex(
            r"A=\begin{bmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{bmatrix}", font_size=32
        ).move_to([0, 1.9, 0])
        status = Text("Unit square: signed area +1", font_size=26)
        status.move_to([0, 1.15, 0])
        shape = geometry(unit, normal_offsets)
        self.play(FadeIn(heading_a), FadeIn(status), FadeIn(shape), run_time=1)
        trace(unit, "O → u → u+v → v: counterclockwise")

        a = np.array([[2., 1.], [0., 1.]])
        a_vertices = unit @ a.T
        result_a = MathTex(
            r"\det(A)=2\cdot1-1\cdot0=+2", font_size=30
        ).move_to(status)
        self.play(
            Transform(shape, geometry(a_vertices, normal_offsets)),
            Transform(status, result_a),
            run_time=3,
        )
        trace(a_vertices, "Counterclockwise stays counterclockwise")
        note_a = Text("Area = 2   •   Orientation preserved", font_size=25)
        note_a.move_to([0, -3.05, 0])
        self.play(FadeIn(note_a), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(shape), FadeOut(heading_a), FadeOut(status), FadeOut(note_a),
            run_time=0.5,
        )

        # Separate example: start again from the original unit square.
        heading_b = MathTex(
            r"B=\begin{bmatrix}-1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix}", font_size=32
        ).move_to([0, 1.9, 0])
        status_b = Text("Fresh unit square: signed area +1", font_size=26)
        status_b.move_to([0, 1.15, 0])
        shape_b = geometry(unit, normal_offsets)
        self.play(
            FadeIn(heading_b), FadeIn(status_b), FadeIn(shape_b), run_time=1
        )
        trace(unit, "O → u → u+v → v: counterclockwise")

        b = np.array([[-1., 0.], [0., 1.]])
        b_vertices = unit @ b.T
        result_b = MathTex(
            r"\det(B)=(-1)\cdot1-0\cdot0=-1", font_size=30
        ).move_to(status_b)
        self.play(
            Transform(shape_b, geometry(b_vertices, reflected_offsets)),
            Transform(status_b, result_b),
            run_time=3,
        )
        trace(b_vertices, "Same corner order, now clockwise: orientation reversed")
        note_b = Text("Area = 1   •   Signed area = −1", font_size=25)
        note_b.move_to([0, -3.05, 0])
        self.play(FadeIn(note_b), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(2)
        # Total scheduled animation duration: 24 seconds.
```
